title: Vego Sausages and Roast Potatoes
subtitle: with French Onion Gravy and Green Beans
description: Go plant-based but keep snags on the menu. Simply roast kale and cashew sausages, smother them in onion gravy and serve with crunchy potatoes and tender beans. Yes please!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line 2 oven trays with baking paper. Thinly slice the onion. Trim the beans. Finely chop the parsley, including the stems. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove. Crumble 1 stock cube into a heatproof jug, add 250ml (1 cup) boiling water and stir to dissolve.

Roast potatoes: Quarter the unpeeled potatoes and put on a lined tray. Drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper and turn to coat. Roast, turning halfway, for 25 mins or until tender. Put the sausages on the remaining lined tray (see Kitchen 101) and drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil. Roast for 10 mins or until warmed through.

Toast almonds: Meanwhile, put the almonds in a cold small frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan. Heat 2 tsp olive oil in the same pan. Cook the onion, stirring, for 5 mins or until softened. Add the parsley stems and garlic and cook for a further 30 secs or until fragrant.

Cook gravy: Add 2 tsp plain flour to the onion mixture and cook, stirring, for 20 secs or until golden. Gradually add the stock and 1 tbs balsamic vinegar, stirring constantly, and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 3-5 mins until slightly thickened. Taste the gravy, then season with salt and pepper. Remove the pan from the heat.

Serve up: Bring a small saucepan of water to the boil. Cook the beans for 2-3 mins until tender. Drain. Divide the sausages, gravy, potatoes and beans among plates. Scatter the almonds over the beans and the remaining parsley over the sausages. Enjoy!
Kitchen 101: When cooking the sausages, ensure they don't touch as they may stick together.
